sana: quick async standup — kernel + batching + KV perf notes
alex: what I did yesterday: ran microbench for microbatch=8 on canary; p95 down ~8% vs last run
jamie: what I did: exercised shard7 with heavy prefix-cache loads, hit OOM once (details below)
lee: what I did: landed small backoff tweak to the batcher (branch: batcher/backoff-tilt)
sana: blockers?
jamie: blocker: OOM on shard7 when batchsize=12 and prefetch=64, suspect slot steal + KV growth
jamie: repro log snippet:
```
2026-03-17T08:12:04Z shard=7 alloc failed: requested=1.2GB available=900MB
batcher: slot 3 -> 5 steal triggered
KV: cache_size=68MB entries=524k
```
alex: thanks. quick mitigation: reduce per-slot prefetch to 32 and throttle batcher inflight in canary config
lee: already pushed config change to canary: `prefetch_limit=32` and `max_inflight=24` — rolling now
bench-bot: perf job #812 finished: p50=12ms, p95=78ms, throughput=220rps, notes="batcher backoff enabled"
sana: today: finalize KV eviction tuning, add KV warmup to perf harness, review CR #4523 (batcher backoff), and follow up on OOM RCA
alex: I'll review CR #4523 in the next hour :thumbsup:
jamie: I'll open ticket for KV warmup + heatmap (ticket 3542) and attach the OOM traces
lee: ping @eng-sre to temporary increase canary memory headroom?
alex: pinged eng-sre in #eng-sre, they acknowledged and will monitor for next hour
sana: cool — unless anything else urgent, I'll collect these notes for the sprint sync. If you hit fresh blockers drop here and tag me. :coffee:
